controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: USGS Cassini/Voyager mosaic, about 154 m per source pixel, downsampled to the shared 8192 × 4096 layout. Photographed shadows and variable resolution remain; globe Shadows adds approximate lighting. Gray grid marks explicit source no-data. Spherical shape approximation.

controls.label: Enhanced color
controls.description: Published 2014 enhanced-color composite, photometrically corrected by Paul Schenk. Colors extend beyond human vision into ultraviolet and infrared. Source resolution varies; seams and residual photographed shading remain. Spherical shape approximation.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Color shows height above the PDS 561.4 km reference sphere. Brightness shows fixed northwest relief lighting at true height scale; Shadows adds shared approximate globe lighting. Cassini SPC model released in 2025, about 1.58 km grid spacing. The globe remains spherical; model detail and accuracy vary.
